Henry David Thoreau, A Week on the Concord and Merrimack Rivers.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/henry-david-thoreau/a-week-on-the-concord-and-merrimack-rivers

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Henry David Thoreau, an author, died 1862.

First publication of the text used: 1849 (SE colophon: 'A Week on the Concord and Merrimack Rivers was published in 1849 (and revised in 1868) by Henry David Thoreau.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1849. The edition's own statement of rights (quoted below) says the text is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication. Every person named above died in 1862 or earlier, so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
